( 004 — MANIFESTO )

The machines are arriving. Let’s make sure they arrive somewhere worth being.

A note on building in the open,
with care, curiosity and conviction.

01

We believe progress should feel like expansion, not extraction.

Technology is at its best when it gives more people more ways to be fully human.

02

We make room for mystery.

Not every useful thing can be quantified. Not every question wants an immediate answer.

03

We choose aliveness over optimization.

We build systems that surprise us, challenge us, and leave the world with more texture than they found.

04

We stay accountable to the worlds we touch.

Every model has a material footprint and a social consequence. We hold both in view.

( A LITTLE MORE LIFE )

Build something
worth inheriting.
